verdict.rationale: Instinct documents a settings tool to delete all data indexed from external sources (app.instinct.com/workspace), the ability to revoke connected-account access, and a training opt-out. Community reports confirm the delete tool was added after a tester couldn't get Gmail records deleted. However, disconnecting a source leaves already-indexed data stored (one tester still got email summaries hours after disconnecting) until the separate delete tool is used, and there are no documented retention-period controls. missing for 10: configurable retention periods or automatic purge on disconnect, documented per-item/conversation-history deletion and account-deletion process, independent hands-on confirmation that the delete tool fully purges data.
